topic: A person discovers the tree they planted as a child has been cut down
text: I remember the day I planted that tree, a small sapling nestled into the earth with such care and anticipation. It stood there, a silent witness to my growth, from childhood into the person I am now. Learning it’s been cut down, I find myself pausing, reflecting on the years it marked with each passing season. It’s a reminder of the fleeting nature of things, yet the memory of planting it remains vivid. I can still guide my fingers through the soil, feeling the earth beneath, just as I did then. While the loss stirs a deep sense of reflection, I hold onto the lessons learned from nurturing it. Life, in its cycles, teaches us to let go and to cherish the enduring impact of our actions.
